quotations:
Ricursive Intelligence
just released
Ripple-65B Preview
. Ripple-65B Preview is a 65B dense open-weight model from Ricursive, pretrained from scratch for agentic coding. It is a general-purpose variant of the proprietary model behind Ricursive’s AI chip design platform. The main claim:
80.52 on Terminal-Bench 2.1
, the top self-reported score among US open-weight models. Every MoE rival it beats on that test carries 501B to 975B total parameters.

The release includes
3 checkpoints
: an instruction-tuned BF16 model, an
NVFP4 version
, and a
BF16 base model
. All ship under Apache 2.0. Pretraining used a text-only corpus, mostly English and code, at 8K sequence length.
